events.title: Baby Sensory Play Time
events.description: Join us for a special program designed for babies and their caregivers to explore sights, sounds, and textures in a safe and friendly environment. Develop early motor skills and engage their senses through fun activities every other week.

events.title: Tiny Tots Art
events.description: A fun art program for toddlers and preschoolers to explore colors, crafts, and creativity with their caregivers.

events.title: Make & Take Craft
events.description: Come in with the kids and enjoy a self guided craft that's available all day long. Each week features a different theme. We look forward to seeing you here.

events.title: SD Nights @ the Vista Library
events.description: Join us in the Vista Library parking lot as the County of San Diego Park and Recreation's SD Nights makes an appearance with activities and pizza. While supplies last.
events.location: Vista Library Parking Lot, Vista, CA

events.title: Wiggles and Giggles Storytime
events.description: Designed for babies and toddlers, this action-packed storytime focuses on the development of our youngest friends and helps them form an early love of reading. Each week we'll have 30 minutes of engaging activities and 30 minutes of play.

events.title: Family Play Time Hour
events.description: Please join us for Family Play Time Hour, a chance for our little ones to play with our toys and make new friends! Children and their families are welcome to join in the fun! Geared towards ages 0-5.

events.description: Join us for  LOOT & LORE every Wednesday afternoon at the 4S Ranch Library! Featuring: Dungeons & Dragons, Daggerheart, Warriors, POKÉMON & Magic: The Gathering  GRADES 4-12!  Make new friends! Play tabletop games, trading cards, roleplaying and more! Dive into epic quests, discover hidden treasures, and forge new friendships in a thrilling fantasy adventure. Fun awaits every adventurer!
